input.quote: Upon the occurrence of any Change of Control (as defined below) this Agreement and all Licensee's rights and licenses hereunder shall automatically terminate unless, prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control, Licensor has consented to such Change of Control in a writing executed by an officer of Licensor
input.rationale:
The Article II grant (p0030) runs to Licensee alone, and the restrictions confine access to "employees of the Licensee" (p0045), so our Affiliates have no coverage and no notice-based path to it. On transferability, Licensee may not assign or transfer its licence rights without consent (p0149), and any merger, asset sale or change of control automatically terminates the Agreement and all licences unless Licensor consents in advance (p0134) — consent that is deemed reasonably withheld on broad grounds. The clause therefore fails both fallback elements (affiliates on written notice; transfer to an M&A successor), so we have made the shortest fallback-level edits: affiliates on written notice in the grant, a conforming change to the employee-access restriction, and a successor-transfer carve-out from the Change of Control auto-termination. We have not pursued the preferred perpetual/irrevocable and contractor elements.</parationale>
